graphql.query: query EventById($eventId: ID!) { event(id: $eventId) { id slug title beginsAt endsAt htmlDescription isLive language timezone totalPlannings totalExhibitors totalSpeakers banner { imageUrl embeddedVideo { videoId } } address { place street city zipCode state country } groups { id name peopleCount } } }
